name: Stefano Ricci
why: Florentine opulence — silk, crocodile, monumental shirting.
origin: Stefano Ricci, Florence, 1972 — began with monumental silk ties.
opview: Positions true luxury as handmade, Florentine, and unapologetic.

notes.boat: The same register as Zilli, in Florence, and equally unbothered about the distinction between a yacht and a stage.
notes.ital: Florence, with its own silk mill at Antico Setificio Fiorentino. Maximal Italian luxury, unembarrassed about it, and vertically integrated further than most houses three times its size.

cities: NYC, Beverly Hills, Vegas · Philadelphia (Boyds), Neiman
